overview:
Mainstreet Research is a New York-based expert network focused on primary research for the investment community. Founded in 2016, the company serves hedge funds, asset managers, and sell-side analysts with expert consultations, channel checks, and proprietary research insights.

The company differentiates through its channel check expertise — systematic programs that collect data points from industry participants to identify trends in company performance, market dynamics, and competitive positioning. This primary research approach appeals to investors who need actionable, investable insights rather than general industry education.
